description: which returns the pathnames of the files (or links) which would be executed in the current environment, had its arguments been given as commands in a strictly POSIX-conformant shell. It does this by searching the PATH for executable files matching the names of the arguments. It does not canonicalize path names.

options.desc: print all matching pathnames of each argument
silently return 0 if all of the executables were found or 1 otherwise
